usedFor: Shopify holds your store and Sangam CRM holds sales, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Create a new Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a new Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Shoppers who leave at checkout have given an email or phone, and the action adds a lead.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the lead appears after a scheduled check, not when the shopper leaves.
